Read input: autovcoder_024255.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_024255 (
    input DCK,
    input rst,
    input DEN,

    output reg CENB
);

  parameter IDLE = 2'b00, IN = 2'b01, WRITE = 2'b10;
  reg [1:0] cstate, nstate;


  always @(posedge DCK, posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) cstate <= IDLE;
    else cstate <= nstate;
  end

  always @* begin
    case (cstate)
      IDLE: begin
        if (DEN) nstate = IN;
        else nstate = IDLE;
      end
      IN: begin
        if (DEN) nstate = IN;
        else nstate = WRITE;
      end
      WRITE: begin
        if (DEN) nstate = IN;
        else nstate = WRITE;
      end
      default: nstate = IDLE;
    endcase
  end

  always @* begin
    case (cstate)
      IDLE: begin
        CENB = 1'b1;
      end
      IN: begin
        CENB = DEN;
      end
      WRITE: begin
        CENB = DEN;
      end
      default: CENB = 1'b1;
    endcase
  end

endmodule
